scope: @keld/electron BrowserWindow cells for the draw.io first-proof window path on macOS at Electron 44.4.5; not median-app product compatibility

doc_citation.quote: A `Integer` property representing the unique ID of the window. Each ID is unique among all `BrowserWindow` instances of the entire Electron application.

cells.test_name: window.constructor.host-id: exported constructor refuses to mint a local ID without Host Ready
cells.negative_control: Removing the exported constructor or returning a fabricated local WindowId with no authenticated Host fails the Bun admission test; real Host identity is separately asserted by facade_window acceptance, and parity stays held until its corpus runner owns that observable.

doc_citation.quote: Emitted when a new [browserWindow](browser-window.md) is created.

cells.test_name: app.browser-window-created.once-per-window: unhosted constructor emits no creation event
cells.negative_control: Emitting browser-window-created for a failed or unhosted Create fails. The macOS native acceptance independently counts exactly one event for a successful Host Create.

doc_citation.quote: Emitted when a new [webContents](web-contents.md) is created.

cells.test_name: app.web-contents-created.once-per-window: unhosted constructor emits no content event
cells.negative_control: Emitting web-contents-created for a failed or unhosted Create fails. The native acceptance independently pins the successful event once and its creation order.

cells.test_name: app.window-created-events.constructor-order: no fabricated events before Host Create
cells.negative_control: Synthesizing either creation event without a successful authenticated Host Create fails. This source-only Electron ordering cell remains unknown.

doc_citation.quote: Returns `BrowserWindow[]` - An array of all opened browser windows.

cells.test_name: window.get-all-windows.sync: local empty read has no Host side effects
cells.negative_control: Removing the synchronous static getter or returning a fabricated local window when no Host windows exist fails. Real macOS acceptance separately asserts it holds the Host-created window.

cells.test_name: window.get-all-windows.order: no window can be invented by the local collection
cells.negative_control: Inventing a window locally without a host identity fails. The upstream ordering oracle is source-only and remains unknown.

doc_citation.quote: Returns `BrowserWindow | null` - The window that is focused in this application, otherwise returns `null`.

cells.test_name: window.get-focused-window.sync: no focused window without native fact
cells.negative_control: Returning a locally invented focused window without an observed Host Focus fact fails. Full native focus parity is not yet qualified.

cells.test_name: window.maximize.state-in-listener: exposed accessors cannot construct without Host Ready
cells.negative_control: Removing maximize or isMaximized from the prototype fails. Host-confirmed maximization inside a real listener is not established by this shape test.

doc_citation.quote: When querying for a BrowserWindow's fullscreen status, you should ensure that either the ['enter-full-screen'](browser-window.md#event-enter-full-screen) or ['leave-full-screen'](browser-window.md#event-leave-full-screen) events have been emitted.

cells.test_name: window.set-full-screen.state: exposed accessors cannot construct without Host Ready
cells.negative_control: Removing setFullScreen or isFullScreen from the prototype fails. Native fullscreen event confirmation remains unqualified.

doc_citation.quote: It creates a new `BrowserWindow` with native properties as set by the `options`.

cells.test_name: window.constructor.drawio-options: safe draw.io options pass security triage but cannot create without Host
cells.negative_control: Rejecting pinned safe draw.io options as a privilege escalation instead of reaching the missing-Host Ready boundary fails. draw.io preload and app-content launch remain unimplemented.

doc_citation.quote: It creates a new `BrowserWindow` with native properties as set by the `options`.

cells.test_name: window.constructor.escalating-web-preferences: six unsafe values refuse before Host access
cells.negative_control: Accepting any of the six escalating preferences or returning CORE-040 instead of explicit COMPAT-010 fails the safe-constructor triage.

cells.test_name: window.close-event.prevent-default: close method is exposed only on Host-backed windows
cells.negative_control: Removing the close method fails; the separate native macOS acceptance proves preventDefault keeps the identical on-screen window until another close.

cells.test_name: window.destroy.closed-without-close: destroy method is exposed only on Host-backed windows
cells.negative_control: Removing destroy fails. The native macOS acceptance separately proves destroy emits closed without close after real release.

cells.test_name: window.closed.is-destroyed-in-listener: public isDestroyed requires a Host-created window
cells.negative_control: Removing isDestroyed fails. The source-only Electron order remains unknown despite native Keld tombstone observation.
